title: First classified tour on Eleuthera, Bahamas, with an air-rescue cover

tellings.quote: I was on a Luther in the Bahamas

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former US Army man, says his first classified posting came in the 1960s on Eleuthera, an island in the Bahamas, and that it was hidden behind a cover story of air-rescue work. He tells Michels this from his own life, saying simply, "I was on a Luther in the Bahamas," and gives no more about what the secret work was.
